scope: Retained bounded IGN approach/valley observations and literal OSM bridge/road features, supporting a separate reconstructed arch above unchanged valley ground.
limits: Source accuracy is variable, as retained literally. Bridgecenter values are valley ground and must not be assigned to the separate elevated deck. The4.3 m maxheight tag cites road vehicle clearance at TunnelduLarvotto, not archrise or deckelevation. Approach ground samples require actual street/abutment qualification before selecting a vertical anchor.

architectural_decisions.anchor_basis: Median centerline ground of the 2 / 4 / 6 m outside nonbridge approach probes. End/node and valley ground values are not assumed to be deck elevations. Vertical line across the bridge is original architectural inference, not a deck DSM. Variable source accuracy retained.
architectural_decisions.estimated_dimensions: Arch rise, crown/parapet dimensions and transition distance are bounded original reconstruction from the 2024 photograph taken at the site and approach heights. No measured engineering elevation/section of the bridge recovered.
architectural_decisions.ground_policy: Existing field represents valley ground, with~6.6 m low point between~22.5 m road approaches. Preserve it below the arch. No prism, hillside flattening, terraincutout or native driving/contact change. Exact original ground planes required only at bounded approach ties; no geometry outside mapped bridge/qualified nonbridge support strips changes.
architectural_decisions.source_licences: Literal OSM outline/centerline, ODbL 1.0. Literal IGN approach/valley observations, Open Licence 2.0.2024 photo review-only, no texture copying.
architectural_decisions.source_epoch_note: OSM retained snapshot and 2024 primary arch photograph; 2019 orthophoto. Supplied edited reference year unverified.
architectural_decisions.status: Bridge plan and approach-based anchors source qualified; arch rise/crown/parapet estimates require cooked live review.

source_epoch_note: Supplied edited reference year unverified; 2019 ortho and 2024 primary arch photograph are dated. Current date does not establish game/event year.
